title: Container history
description: One container (a region): the region as the ledger stores it, the agents that hold it, and every node it has held, each with its full history.

board.description: The board the container is on.

region.description: The container itself: its id, title, mode and lanes.

holders.description: Empty for a region written by a v2 line

nodes.description: Every node the container has held, each with all its versions and notes; a retired card carries `retired`.

notes.description: The person's notes on the whole container, oldest first; a removed note is left out.

retired.description: The ledger line that took the container off the board with its cards, for a retired container; left out while it is on the board.

pin.description: Where the person placed the container: its frame's top-left in board coordinates. Left out when it is where layout puts it.
